newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 5.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* Universal TV president Tom Thayer is set to take an exclusive development and production job at the studio starting in August.
* Broadcasters are readying to revise the new content-based TV ratings.
* Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS and Time Warner Inc's cable networks, TBS and TNT, have agreed to share 15 titles within four years.

* The 1960s may be too rich of fodder. While duelling Janis Joplin flicks are set to premier this fall, two other rival projects are being offered up: a film on activist Abbie Hoffman and the Cuban missile crisis.
* Jaffe-Braunstein Films has acquired the rights to Mockery of Justice: The True Story of the Sheppard Murder Case for a two-hour special on CBS.
* Ken Gross, a principal in Paradigm, is set to depart the agency to become a manager-producer, while Paradigm adds agent Debbee Klein as a principal.
